title: Insulin action times

findings.where: Images 8 and 16; step "worked"; amber peak-window rectangle
findings.title: Peak-window shading lacks a visible boundary
findings.problem: The amber rectangle uses 0.16 fill opacity with no outline—approximately 1.1:1 contrast against the light background and 1.3:1 against the dark background. Unlike the outlined peak pills, its edges are difficult to locate, weakening the visual connection between the clock-time label and the 4–12-hour interval.
findings.fix: Add high-contrast vertical boundary lines or a bracket using C.labInk. Keep the pale amber fill as decoration rather than the only way to identify the interval’s boundaries.

assessment: One accessibility defect: the worked example’s peak-window boundaries are too faint.
